headline: David Clayton-Thomas, Canadian Singer of Blood, Sweat & Tears, Dies at 84
context: He was also the key lyricist of the Grammy-winning, genre-blending band, whose hits included “Spinning Wheel,” “And When I Die” and “You’ve Made Me So Very Happy.”
